welcome_page.title: Environment and your trips
welcome_page.description:
How noise, air, weather and the look of places affect your trips. It takes about 2 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

sections.title: Before we start
sections.description: A few quick questions to put your answers in context.

questions.text: Which way of travelling do you use most often?

options.text: Taxi or app-based car service (e.g. Uber, FreeNow)

questions.text: How much does traffic noise bother you when you are out?
How does air pollution (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells) affect how you travel?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself (e.g. mask, closed windows)
I use another way of travelling

questions.text: How does bad weather (rain, wind, cold, great heat) affect how you travel?

options.text: It's less comfortable, but I don't change anything
I postpone or avoid some trips
I use another way of travelling

questions.text: How do dirt and poor maintenance (litter, smells, broken glass) affect your trips?

options.text: I notice them, but carry on as usual
They make the trip unpleasant, but I use the same route
I avoid some places or stretches

questions.text: How much do pleasant surroundings (buildings, squares, views) affect your trips?

options.text: I notice them, but they rarely change anything
I sometimes choose routes because they are nicer

it.#<p>How noise, air, weather and the look:
Come rumore, aria, meteo e aspetto dei luoghi influiscono sui tuoi spostamenti. Richiede circa 2 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.
